confusions.issue: COMMS never names the conversation you are in. The header always reads COMMS (it shows the project name only inside a project), so the session title appears only on the highlighted rail row.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: Sessions get created automatically, and ON THE LINE or a starter can switch conversations, so users type without knowing which conversation they are in.
confusions.evidence: frontend/app/chat.js:1922-1980 (load never writes #comms-title); only project-home.js:50,79 write it; app.js:4684 comment 'refresh the COMMS header title' refers to a title that does not exist

confusions.issue: Many features create sessions without being asked: one per hire, quest, starter idea, app, OUTBOX follow-up and routine run, plus away builds, phone chats, project homes and a group made from General. These sit beside the hidden worker threads.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: The rail fills with empty or one-off rows (RESEARCH, COPY, quest: …, App · …). Clicking a starter or quest moves COMMS away from the running conversation.
confusions.evidence: app.js:1175; stationui.js:10104; chat.js:2301; apps.js:157; outbox.js:267; autosessions.js:123; FINDINGS #8, #18, #19 (still NEEDS ANDREW'S CALL)

confusions.issue: One approval shows up in up to 7+ places, uses different words in each, and offers different grades: only the COMMS card has Always and Full access, while NEEDS YOU, delegated rows and group rows offer only Approve once/Deny.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: Users can't tell which surface is the real one, and they find a different set of choices depending on where they answer.
confusions.evidence: chat.js:3976-3981 vs needsyou.js:108, delegated.js:215-217, group-chat.js:620; FINDINGS #1, #28

confusions.issue: There are two lists both labelled NEEDS YOU. The SESSIONS rail list can approve and deny, and the NOTIFICATIONS window section can only OPEN. The CREW card adds a third wording ('needs your OK').
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: Two lists with the same name behave differently, and users can't tell which one to work from.

confusions.issue: Typing while the agent works silently queues the message as a pill that auto-sends after the run ends. It does not steer the task. The exception is when exactly one question is open, where the text becomes the answer. Channel DMs steer instead, and /steer is separate.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: A user who adds context mid-run gets a duplicate job later. The release notes promise 'a follow-up joins the running task', but that applies only to chat apps.
confusions.evidence: chat.js:1316-1325, 7891-7946; NOTES_DRAFT.md Behavior changes; FINDINGS #11, #42 (a duplicate run burned real spend)

confusions.issue: There are four question-card designs with different answer mechanics: the in-turn key card, the TaskConversation card with its own textarea, the end-run '⌖' chip row (type in the composer) and the group card tied to the composer, plus the Fork card.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: Users can't tell whether to tap a chip, type in the card or type in the main box.

confusions.issue: Typing @name in a direct chat permanently turns that chat into a group chat (from General it spawns a new group instead). The + key does the same, and the change is never confirmed.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: Mentioning someone to ask a quick question changes the conversation type and its routing (un-@'d messages now go to the lead).

confusions.issue: The ON THE LINE selector looks like 'who answers here', but it actually switches to that agent's latest session or creates a new one. On a blank session it rebinds the agent instead. The HUD deliberately avoids that rebind.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: Users expect to change the agent in the current chat. Instead the transcript disappears, or a new agent-named row appears.

confusions.issue: Clicking a CREW row does one of three things: it opens the waiting session if the agent is asking, narrows SESSIONS on a multi-agent station, or opens the dossier on a solo station.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: The same gesture gives different results, and the narrowed rail looks like conversations have gone missing (only a small chip explains it).

confusions.issue: The slash palette has 43+ commands that use 'workstream' wording and overlap each other: /new vs /clear vs /reset, /cron vs /routine, /agents (alias /tasks) vs MY WORK › TASKS, /fast vs /reasoning, /resume alias /sessions. Recipes are mixed in as commands, and an empty '/' shows only 8 items.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: The vocabulary doesn't match the rail ('SESSIONS'), and near-duplicate commands make the right one hard to pick.

confusions.issue: Clicking a project opens a separate 'project home' conversation and renames COMMS. That conversation also appears as an ordinary SESSIONS row. The project ⋯ items 'Open project' and 'Open project COMMS' do the same thing, and the overview's per-project session previews never render.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: PROJECTS and SESSIONS overlap, and users can't tell where a project's conversations live.

confusions.issue: Delegated work has two control panels that offer different controls. The conversation card has Stop/See work/Approve but no steering, and the project ACTIVITY panel has SEND DIRECTION and STOP WORK.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: Users can't tell where to manage a worker, and steering exists only in a panel most users never open.

confusions.issue: NEEDS YOU is not the one list the release notes promise ('everything waiting on you sits in one list'). Pending workshop builds (NEEDS A DECISION), TO REVIEW crates, PROPOSALS, quest attests, GOAL LOOP results waiting review, STEP-IN sign-ins, extension approvals and questions inside a finished reply are all absent from the rail.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: They clear NEEDS YOU and believe nothing is waiting, while decisions sit in DELIVERABLES, QUESTS, AUTOMATE › GOAL LOOPS, the CREW dock badge and the bell.
confusions.evidence: needsyou.js:50-88 (sources: Channels.allPending, GroupChat, overseer workers, cron sessions only); deliverables.js:215,354-356; stationui.js:10751-10757,10790-10803; windows/loops.js:781; stepin.js:94; app.js:5763; chat.js:10149-10150; NOTES_DRAFT.md 'everything waiting on you sits in one list'

confusions.issue: There are two different NEEDS YOU lists. The SESSIONS rail list is computed live; the NOTIFICATIONS section is stored entries. They have different sources, counts and dismiss state. Muting NEEDS APPROVAL in SETTINGS › ALERTS removes bell entries but not rail rows, and the rail's Dismiss is local storage that never touches the bell.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: The two show different numbers for the same idea, so neither can be trusted as the answer to 'what needs me?'.

confusions.issue: The DELIVERABLES window has two 'CLEAR ALL' buttons stacked one above the other with different effects. TO REVIEW's '✓ CLEAR ALL N' drops rating reminders. The library's 'CLEAR ALL N / CLEAR THESE' hides cards. Beside them sit CLEAN OLD RECORDS (deletes records), CLEAR <bucket>, and ✓ DONE · CLEAR on every card.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: A user trying to tidy up cannot tell which clear loses what, and the TO REVIEW clear also forfeits the rating (XP) step.

confusions.issue: TO REVIEW's inclusion rule is invisible. It holds only runs that finished while the app was closed (never in a first session), RUN ONE REAL JOB samples, WORKFLOWS jobs and SEND TO hand-offs. Attended chats never appear. Yet the glossary and dock tips describe it as 'finished runs waiting for your rating'.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: A new user's first finished work never shows in TO REVIEW, so the section is missing or looks broken. Rating actually happens in COMMS.

confusions.issue: Finished work appears in 15+ places, and one clean WORKFLOWS job lands in four at once: WORKFLOWS LAST JOBS, the floor OUTBOX pallet, TO REVIEW, and the library as a kind 'workflow' row. A filed notification can make it five.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: There is no single answer to 'where is my output?'. The field manual itself gives three different answers (COMMS Sessions, DELIVERABLES, TASKS).

confusions.issue: QUESTS › Progress shows five level-like numbers: STATION SYSTEMS N OF M ONLINE, COMMANDER LEVEL, STATION EVOLUTION, Station prestige STATION LEVEL, and 'AGENT GROWTH Lv N'. The last is mislabelled: it is the station XP rollup (the same numbers as Station prestige) but sits beside OPEN IN THE DOSSIER, which opens one agent's GROWTH.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: They cannot tell which level matters or what raises it. One meter claims to be agent growth while showing station data, which breaks the truthful-telemetry law.

confusions.issue: The floor OUTBOX hover says 'N TO REVIEW — CLICK', but the click opens WORKFLOWS on the line's newest job. WORKFLOWS has no rate or collect control, so the crates never go down from there.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: The tag promises review and the click lands somewhere else that cannot clear it. The crate count looks stuck.

confusions.issue: The away digest's footer says 'the crate on the floor holds these until you review them.' Since 10-03, routine, chat and away runs never stack on a chute. Only line jobs do.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: The user searches the floor for crates that do not exist.

confusions.issue: The standing FLOOR quest mints 'The station reached for DELIVERY — place a OUTBOX in its bay / its run hit a wall' whenever TO REVIEW has crates and no OUTBOX is placed. No run hit a wall, and placing an OUTBOX will not surface away work.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: It teaches the retired OUTBOX-as-inbox model and sends them to BUILD MODE for nothing. The copy is also ungrammatical ('a OUTBOX').

confusions.issue: MY WORK opens on TASKS by default. TASKS lists only kind:'task' streams, so a new user's chats and finished work are not there. The tutorial still calls TASKS 'everything i’m doing'.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: The first click on 'tasks, finished work & ready-made jobs' shows an empty board with a paragraph explaining that their work lives elsewhere.

confusions.issue: TASKS has its own review flow ('FINISHED — REVIEW RESULT' → MARK COMPLETE). It is unrelated to TO REVIEW rating, to the library's NEEDS A DECISION, and to XP. Its 'N deliverables' chip is not a link.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: Two 'review' steps live in sibling tabs of one window with different meanings. Marking a task complete does not rate or file anything.

confusions.issue: NEEDS YOU is hidden in the PROJECTS view and whenever the CREW rail is collapsed (◂), and the '▸ CREW' handle shows no count. The notification history sits inside the SYSTEM menu, whose badge also shows 'NEW' when an update is ready.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: Attention items vanish with a layout choice, and a number on SYSTEM could mean an approval, a result, an alert or an update.

confusions.issue: Deciding on a workshop build uses different words in different places. The COMMS card offers Implement / Build it / Save patch file, Later and Discard. DELIVERABLES offers KEEP IT and DISCARD, and the result reads KEPT or IMPLEMENTED. 'Later' leaves a NEEDS A DECISION row that NEEDS YOU never shows.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: It is unclear whether Implement equals KEEP IT, and a deferred build is easy to forget.

confusions.issue: There is no E-STOP on the desk. The only station-wide stop is the OS tray item 'Pause Automation (E-STOP)', or asking an agent to press it. The desk shows only RESUME AUTOMATION, and only after a stop. Harness.haltAll is exported but nothing in the UI calls it.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: Error text and approval cards mention E-STOP and RESUME AUTOMATION, but a newcomer cannot find a stop-everything control when something runs away.
confusions.evidence: main.rs:5123; station-control.js:296; index.html:580; emergency-control.js:1-2 ('can only resume, never stop'); harness.js:1194, 1653 (no callers); friendlyerror.js:226-227

confusions.issue: Tuning any AUTONOMY dial button (even PACE) or clicking any PERMISSIONS posture card silently lifts a durable E-STOP halt. Routines and night-shift work resume.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: Someone who stopped everything and then adjusts a setting restarts automation without being told.

confusions.issue: Whether an agent asks first can be set in 8 places with different words: 2 choices at onboarding, 3 postures, 2 crew-row chips, a dossier card, 'Full access' on the approval card, /yolo, phone ALWAYS ASK, and the whole-station override, which outranks every row.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: Cannot predict which setting wins, or why an agent stopped or kept asking.

confusions.issue: A delegated job in ASK mode raises many prompts. The lead's team.dispatch asks once. Then each worker asks for every risky call, because 'Approve once' covers only that call. Worker rows offer only Approve once or Deny, so Always and Full access cannot be reached from where the ask appears. Unanswered asks auto-deny after CONSENT TIMEOUT (120 s default), a setting buried in APP & BACKUP.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: N workers × M risky steps means N×M prompts across 7 surfaces. The job stalls or gets auto-denied, and the user cannot say 'yes to all' for this job.
confusions.evidence: sidecar/tools/builtin/orchestration.js:713 (requiresConsent, execute); sidecar/permissions.js:233 (once = this call only); delegated.js:215-216, 447-448; chat.js:3922-3928; sidecar/index.js:889; stationui.js:7197

confusions.issue: Credentials are split. Model keys live in SETTINGS › AI & MODELS › API KEYS. Platform keys live in CONNECT › ABILITIES › SAVED API CONNECTIONS. Bot tokens live in CHANNELS. MCP tokens live in CONNECTED SERVICES. The Spotify ID lives in BUILT-IN ABILITIES. Yet the SETTINGS tip says 'Keys'.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: 'Where do I paste my key?' has five answers, and the obvious one (Settings) is wrong for most services.

confusions.issue: A PERMISSIONS posture also rewrites AUTONOMY initiative. LET IT WORK ('the everyday setting') sets level draft → preset build, so agents start acting unattended up to 3 jobs a day. The only warning is a small hint in AUTONOMY.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: A user choosing 'how much access' unknowingly turns on unattended work.

confusions.issue: The trust-offer card and toast name internal rung ids that appear nowhere on the dial: 'raises the dial to LEASH' and 'autonomy raised to LEASH'. The dial shows WAIT / SUGGEST / BUILD / FREE.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: The user cannot match the offer to any setting they can see.

confusions.issue: Several labels point to doors that no longer exist under that name: CATALOG footer says MCP CONNECTORS and KEYS; the keys hint says TOOLSETS; a key row says 'managed in MCP CONNECTORS'; a crew-row toast says 'open ADVANCED on this crew member' when the fold is 'More options — exact reach, asking, sandbox'; ABOUT names the TASK BOARD.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: The user looks for rail labels that are not there.

confusions.issue: BUILT-IN ABILITIES shows an agent picker ('Capabilities for agent'), but the switches POST /api/toolsets/<id> station-wide. The toast prints the raw id, e.g. 'Disabled web'.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: Turning a toolset off 'for this agent' turns it off for everyone.

confusions.issue: CONNECT, the only way to integrations and Telegram, is hidden on a new station until 2 finished jobs or a door routes there. It also sits under the BUILD menu, not SETTINGS.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: A day-one user who wants to connect Gmail or Telegram cannot see where to do it.

confusions.issue: Provider names differ across three surfaces. The onboarding OPENAI chip covers both ChatGPT sign-in and an OpenAI API key, while Settings shows separate CHATGPT (CODEX) and OPENAI API cards. GROK (XAI) and XAI are two separate cards.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: After onboarding the user cannot find 'the provider I picked' under the same name.

confusions.issue: The model dock's scope depends on the focused agent: it is STATION DEFAULT only when the Overseer is focused. Settings text refers to 'your primary model in COMMS' and '(station default)' without saying it means the Overseer's model.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: Changing the model in COMMS sometimes changes every agent and sometimes only one.

confusions.issue: 'Backup' means three unrelated things in Settings: Backup models (fallback chain), ↻ BACKUPS (spare keys), STATION BACKUP (export).
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: Someone looking for 'backup my station' lands on AI & MODELS.

confusions.issue: Four separate unattended engines (AUTONOMY initiative, AWAY WORK queue, SCHEDULES, GOAL LOOPS) are configured in two windows. The AWAY WORK pane needs its own paragraph to explain the difference.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: 'Will my agent work while I'm gone?' has no single answer or place.

confusions.issue: 'SEE FULL ACCESS' in the dossier BRIEF reads like the Full Power mode, but it only opens the access grid.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: A cautious user avoids it, or thinks it grants access.

confusions.issue: Error-door buttons that all open AI & MODELS carry different labels: '⚙ Open Settings', '▸ OPEN AI & MODELS', '＋ Add a key', '⏼ RECONNECT CHATGPT'. The last one only opens settings rather than starting a sign-in.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: A button promises an action and only navigates.

confusions.issue: Onboarding step numbers disagree: the nav says '02 Connect a brain', the section header says '03 THE BRAIN', and the journey list's step 03 is 'Start your first task'.
confusions.whyNewUserStumbles: The first screen's progress markers contradict each other.

confusions.issue: The same update preference is called AUTO-CHECK FOR UPDATES in Settings and CHECK AUTOMATICALLY in the Update Center. An app's AUTO-UPDATE means something else entirely.

orphansAndDeadEnds: Harness.haltAll (station-wide E-STOP) is exported but has no UI caller. The desk can only RESUME AUTOMATION, never stop: harness.js:1194, 1653; emergency-control.js:1-2.
places.js:76 tells the agent that SETTINGS › APP & BACKUP contains START FRESH. It does not (only ERASE EVERYTHING, datareset.js:185-240), so station.show sends users to a missing control.
The SETTINGS › BROWSER description promises 'or in your own Chrome' (stationui.js:7965), but only CHROME WINDOW and BUILT-IN are offered (outputbrowser.js:654-656).

The CATALOG footer points to 'MCP CONNECTORS' and 'KEYS' (connectors.js:192), and a key row says 'managed in MCP CONNECTORS' (connectors.js:1781). The rail tabs are CONNECTED SERVICES and SAVED API CONNECTIONS.
The SAVED API CONNECTIONS hint says 'Check the selected agent in TOOLSETS' (connectors.js:228). The tab is named BUILT-IN ABILITIES.

The crew-row toast 'open ADVANCED on this crew member and save an SSH target' (stationui.js:9002) names a control that does not exist. The fold is 'More options — exact reach, asking, sandbox' (stationui.js:8894).
The BROWSER window has no dock door. It opens only when an agent browses or via station.show (outputbrowser.js:524, 545, 698), yet SETTINGS has a whole BROWSER section for it.
The CREW › STEP-IN dock button stays hidden unless an agent is waiting (index.html:741-742). Saved sign-ins are reachable only through SETTINGS › BROWSER › OPEN SAVED SIGN-INS (stationui.js:7970).

The 'skills' alias maps 'caps' to toolsets, and comments refer to a dossier 'SKILLS tab' (stationui.js:11468-11471, 3716-3721). The dossier has only BRIEF / GROWTH / RECORD / MEMORY / CONFIG (stationui.js:3466-3485).
The ABOUT text points to the 'TASK BOARD' (stationui.js:7824). The dock door and window title read MY WORK › TASKS (stationui.js:1080-1081, 1133).
CONSENT TIMEOUT (MS), which decides when approvals auto-deny, is reachable only in APP & BACKUP › Runtime limits (stationui.js:7197). PERMISSIONS never mentions it.
The toolset toggle toast prints the raw toolset id ('Enabled web', 'Disabled jukebox') rather than the row label (connectors.js:849).

census:automation-build.area: Automation & the build/conveyor layer: AUTOMATE (WORKFLOWS · SCHEDULES · GOAL LOOPS · AWAY WORK), BUILD MODE Conveyors and the Workflow panel, presets and ready-made lines, the machines (INBOX/BAY/OUTBOX/junctions), SEND TO, autonomy and away work, and the automation slash commands. Source: C:/Users/andro/gen-trees/org-pass-1014 @63dfe1489 (0.13.5 RC). New-since-0.13.2 flags come from `git grep` against tag v0.13.2. Counts: 20 ready-made lines (worldmodel.js:491-940), 4 WORKFLOWS starters (windows/workflows.js:385), 7 station presets (5 WORK + 2 LOOK, stationtemplates.js:11-19), 12 room kits the lead agent can place (stationtemplates.js:61-74), 3 goal-loop shapes (loop-templates.js:54-118), 8 conveyor machines. There are 9 user-visible ways to make something run by itself, with no single place that lists them all: (1) a line started from its INBOX by a schedule, channel, folder, webhook or SEND TO; (2) a SCHEDULE (routine) that runs one agent; (3) a GOAL LOOP; (4) /goal; (5) /loop; (6) AWAY WORK (the per-agent build queue); (7) the autonomy initiative WAIT/SUGGEST/BUILD/FREE; (8) /background; (9) APPS AUTO-UPDATE. A LOOP machine also repeats work inside a line.
